global: This is tonkotsu ramen, its rich, creamy broth swirling around tender chashu pork, spinach, and a large nori sheet. A red bowl holds the meal, set on a light wood table under soft, even lighting.

regions.background: Light wood-grain table surface with subtle vertical lines and faint natural wood texture visible.
regions.bowl: Red ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, rounded rim.
regions.soup: The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is creamy, pale yellow, with visible noodles, green spinach, and a large slice of pork belly.
regions.spoon: A glossy red spoon with smooth, curved surface and slightly tapered handle.
regions.egg: A whole boiled egg, pale cream-colored, smooth, oval-shaped, with subtle surface sheen and faintly visible shell texture.
regions.seaweed: The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, triangular-shaped, with a slightly uneven, crinkled surface and visible grainy details.
regions.meat: The chashu pork is a thick, round slice with marbled pink and white meat, showing a slightly glistening surface.
